issue.title: Hold Option to see every idle-agenda task at full detail in a scroll view
issue.description: Proposing bead: bob-cli-66.7 note #2 (epic bob-cli-66 closeout follow-up, triaged by bob-cli-66.land). While Option is held with an empty draft, the idle agenda bypasses the fit planner's fold ladder and shows every Pomodoro and task at full detail in a scrollable region. Releasing Option returns to the planned, folded agenda without moving the editor's eye line.

task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Plan plan:202610/idle_capture_pomodoro_agenda.md (epic bob-cli-66) settled the v1.1 agenda interactions as out of scope: keyboard focus never leaves the editor and rows are read-only in v1. The accepted decision decisions:idle-capture-shows-ledger-agenda lists row clicks, keyboard navigation, and ⌘1…9 insertion under 'Reopens when', so this work should revisit that record.
